title: Anne Hathaway Forgets The Princess Diaries and The Devil Wears Prada Details

lines.en: -Who doesn't love Anne Hathaway?
lines.zh: －誰不愛 Anne Hathaway 呢？

lines.en: Thank you for coming. -That's very nice.
lines.zh: 謝謝你來。－你人真好。

lines.en: But you know when you have a moment, you're just like, "Oh, I'm gonna remember that forever."
lines.zh: 但你知道那種時刻，你會想：「喔，我會永遠記得這一刻。」

lines.en: Thank you so much for that. -There you go. It just happened. Come on. The Roots. -Thank you.
lines.zh: 非常謝謝你。－就是這樣，剛剛就發生了。來吧，The Roots 樂團。－謝謝。

lines.en: Hi, everybody. -Thank you for playing "Reverse Charades" with me.
lines.zh: 大家好。－謝謝你跟我一起玩「反向比手畫腳」。

lines.en: You're a great partner. -Thank you.
lines.zh: 你是很棒的搭檔。－謝謝。

lines.en: You're a great partner. -I mean, are you are you competitive when you play games?
lines.zh: 你是很棒的搭檔。－我是說，你玩遊戲的時候好勝心強嗎？

lines.en: Do you play games at home? -Oh, I don't mean to be. -I know.
lines.zh: 你在家會玩遊戲嗎？－喔，我不是故意的。－我知道。

lines.en: Me neither. -I don't mean to me.
lines.zh: 我也是。－我不是故意的。

lines.en: But then you saw her over there, I was like, "No, it's just a nice, friendly game."
lines.zh: 但你看到她在那邊，我就想：「不，這只是個友善的小遊戲。」

lines.en: And then the last, I'm like, "But the points are on.
lines.zh: 然後到了最後，我就想：「可是分數開始算了。

lines.en: Like, it's on." -Let's go.
lines.zh: 也就是說，來真的了。」－來吧。

lines.en: I want to win this. -Something takes over.
lines.zh: 我想贏。－有某種東西接管了你。

lines.en: I'm less competitive now. -Why? -Kids. -Yeah.
lines.zh: 我現在比較沒那麼好勝了。－為什麼？－因為有孩子了。－對。

lines.en: Yeah. -I think maybe being competitive is genetic, because my kids are, like -- They're competitive, too.
lines.zh: 對。－我覺得好勝心可能是遺傳的，因為我的孩子們……他們也很好勝。

lines.en: And it turns out motherhood has softened me, and I like to watch them win. -Yeah. -Aww. -My kids are very competitive, too.
lines.zh: 結果當了媽媽讓我變溫柔了，我喜歡看他們贏。－對。－噢。－我的孩子也很好勝。

lines.en: Well, my one daughter is. Yeah. Yeah.
lines.zh: 嗯，我其中一個女兒是。對。對。

lines.en: The other one doesn't really care. She's like, "That's fun. It's all good."
lines.zh: 另一個不太在乎。她會說：「很好玩啊，沒關係。」

lines.en: But the other one really wants to win.
lines.zh: 但另一個真的很想贏。

lines.en: And I don't throw the games.
lines.zh: 而且我不會故意放水。

lines.en: You know, I go -- I really -- And I play for -- I play for money, too.
lines.zh: 你知道，我會……我真的會……而且我還會賭錢玩。

lines.en: Are you -- Is there a party game that you're especially good at? -Es-- No.
lines.zh: 你有沒有……有沒有哪個派對遊戲你特別厲害？－特……沒有。

lines.en: I mean, you know, I was playing a game -- We play a lot of Pokémon and we play a lot of Trouble and Sorry!
lines.zh: 我是說，你知道，我在玩一個遊戲……我們常玩寶可夢，也常玩 Trouble 和 Sorry! 這些桌遊。

lines.en: But there is a game -- I was working last week and I was on set, and we were just passing the time.
lines.zh: 但有一個遊戲……我上禮拜在工作，在片場，我們就在打發時間。

lines.en: And have you seen that movie trivia game where it's cards and they -- and it just asks you questions? -Oh, yeah, I've seen -- Like,
lines.zh: 你有看過那種電影問答遊戲嗎？就是一堆卡片，它會一直問你問題。－喔，有，我看過，像是

lines.en: they have a bunch of quizzes, like sports and movies. -And I was just having one of those, like, runs where I couldn't miss.
lines.zh: 他們有一堆題目，像運動、電影。－然後我那時就是那種怎麼答都答對的狀態。

lines.en: Like, I just knew and I was, like, surprising myself. -Well, you know your stuff.
lines.zh: 就是我全都知道，連我自己都很驚訝。－嗯，你很懂嘛。

lines.en: You know movies. -I didn't -- I mean, apparently, I do.
lines.zh: 你很懂電影。－我沒有……我是說，顯然我懂。

lines.en: And then I got to this one question, and they were like, "Oh, okay.
lines.zh: 然後我答到某一題，他們說：「喔，好。

lines.en: So, uh, junior executive assistant, 'Devil Wears Prada.'" I'm just like, "Emily Blunt."
lines.zh: 所以，呃，《穿著 Prada 的惡魔》裡的初級執行助理。」我就說：「Emily Blunt。」

lines.en: And they were like, "No." And it wasn't her. It was me. So...
lines.zh: 他們說：「不對。」不是她，是我。所以……

lines.en: I was gonna say, "Wait..." -But I was genuinely confused.
lines.zh: 我正要說：「等一下……」－但我是真的搞混了。

lines.en: I'm like, "Wait, but it is her."
lines.zh: 我想：「等等，可是就是她啊。」

lines.en: It is. -"That was me, but I'm the..." That's wild.
lines.zh: 就是她啊。－「那是我，但我是那個……」太扯了。

lines.en: See, when it comes to you -- -Yeah, so... -Do you ever -- Do you kind of do a project and then you kind of block it out of your mind or no?
lines.zh: 你看，說到你……－對，所以……－你會不會……你會不會拍完一部作品就有點把它從腦中清掉？

lines.en: You just -- It just so happens you... -I don't know.
lines.zh: 你就……剛好就是……－我不知道。

lines.en: I'm not huge on looking back.
lines.zh: 我不太喜歡回頭看。

lines.en: It is kind of funny when -- Like, because, you know, I was in this movie when I was 17 years old called "The Princess Diaries." -Yeah. -Have you seen it? -I watch you all the time.
lines.zh: 有時候還滿好笑的，因為你知道，我 17 歲的時候演了一部電影叫《麻雀變公主》。－對。－你看過嗎？－我一直都在看你。

lines.en: To this day, I watch you all the time. -Really? -My family loves you. -It must be your girls. -We love you.
lines.zh: 直到今天，我都一直在看你的片。－真的嗎？－我家人都很愛你。－一定是你的女兒們吧。－我們都愛你。

lines.en: Yeah, they love you so much. -I love that it's become kind of one of those family touchstones.
lines.zh: 對，她們超愛你的。－我很喜歡它變成那種全家人共同的經典回憶。

lines.en: So, anyway, people quote it to me all the time, and I don't know what they're talking about.
lines.zh: 總之，大家一直對我引用裡面的台詞，而我都不知道他們在說什麼。

lines.en: I haven't seen it in a minute. -But "Devil Wears Prada" -- I recently saw a photo of you and Anna Wintour.
lines.zh: 我有一陣子沒看了。－不過說到《穿著 Prada 的惡魔》，我最近看到一張你和 Anna Wintour 的照片。

lines.en: You made your kind of Broadway debut together in "Gutenberg! The Musical!"
lines.zh: 你們一起在《Gutenberg! The Musical!》裡算是完成了百老匯首演。

lines.en: You guys stood up. -There she is. -Did the crowd go nuts? -So, they -- So, by the way, I have to say, that's Josh Gad and that's Andrew Rannells.
lines.zh: 你們兩個站起來。－她在那裡。－觀眾有沒有瘋掉？－所以，他們……順帶一提，我得說，那是 Josh Gad 和 Andrew Rannells。

lines.en: They're both dear friends. And they're so -- They were so brilliant in the show.
lines.zh: 他們兩個都是我很要好的朋友。他們在那齣戲裡真的太精彩了。

lines.en: It was really next level.
lines.zh: 真的是更上一層樓。

lines.en: And at the end of the show, they invite two people up onstage.
lines.zh: 在演出最後，他們會邀請兩個人上台。

lines.en: And, so, they said my name first, and the audience had a very nice reaction.
lines.zh: 所以他們先叫了我的名字，觀眾反應很熱烈。

lines.en: And then they said Anna's name, and it was like rock star. -Really? -Yeah, rock star. -Because you don't really see Anna do many things that are outside of her -- -Wear a trucker hat. -Yes, exactly.
lines.zh: 然後他們叫了 Anna 的名字，簡直像搖滾巨星一樣。－真的嗎？－對，像搖滾巨星。－因為你很少看到 Anna 做她那個領域以外的事……－戴卡車司機帽。－對，沒錯。

lines.en: You'd never see Anna Wintour, from Vogue, wear a trucker hat. That's correct, yeah.
lines.zh: 你永遠不會看到《Vogue》的 Anna Wintour 戴卡車司機帽。沒錯，對。

lines.en: But everyone just went nuts.
lines.zh: 但大家都瘋了。

lines.en: She's also a New York icon. -Oh, yeah. -So I think if she shows up at a pizzeria -- -Yeah, she's a New York icon.
lines.zh: 她也是紐約的代表人物。－喔，對。－所以我覺得如果她出現在一家披薩店……－對，她是紐約的代表人物。

lines.en: She's a worldwide icon. -She's a worldwide -- She's everything.
lines.zh: 她是全世界的代表人物。－她是全世界的……她就是一切。

lines.en: Is she fun to share the stage with? -Yeah. Yeah, really, really fun.
lines.zh: 跟她同台好玩嗎？－好玩，對，真的真的很好玩。

lines.en: And just -- She's been incredibly sweet to me,
lines.zh: 而且她……她對我一直非常親切，

lines.en: and I'm very -- I'm just very grateful for our relationship. -She's so cool. -She's so cool. -She's so cool. -So cool. -Do you get nervous around -- I get a little nervous -- -I absolutely do. -You do?
lines.zh: 我非常……我真的非常感謝我們之間的關係。－她好酷。－她好酷。－她好酷。－超酷。－你在她身邊會緊張嗎？我會有點緊張……－我絕對會。－你會？

lines.en: Now, I have less to lose, because I'm never going to be on the cover of Vogue, so I have nothing to worry about.
lines.zh: 我現在比較沒什麼好失去的，因為我永遠不會登上《Vogue》封面，所以我沒什麼好擔心的。

lines.en: But she likes me, and we've been friends for a long time, so I kind of -- I'm comfy around her, so I can -- -I don't mean to -- I try to keep it comfy.
lines.zh: 但她喜歡我，我們也當了很久的朋友，所以我有點……我在她身邊很自在，所以我可以……－我不是故意要……我盡量讓氣氛自在。

lines.en: I try to keep it cozy.
lines.zh: 我盡量讓氣氛溫馨。

lines.en: But inside, my heart is -- I just respect her so much. -Yeah. -But I feel very comfortable around you. -Yeah, good. You should be.
lines.zh: 但在心裡，我的心……我真的非常尊敬她。－對。－但我在你身邊就覺得很自在。－對，很好。你應該的。

lines.en: You should be. I'm your bud. No, please.
lines.zh: 你應該的。我是你的好兄弟。不，拜託。

lines.en: I totally -- I got the respect and also the dig at the same time.
lines.zh: 我完全……我同時收到了尊敬和吐槽。

lines.en: So it was perfect. -That's how well I know you.
lines.zh: 所以太完美了。－這就是我有多了解你。

lines.en: That's how cozy I am. -Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: 這就是我有多自在。－對，沒錯。

lines.en: You know, I saw you, by the way -- I was going to say on Broadway, but it wasn't.
lines.zh: 你知道，順帶一提，我看過你……我本來要說在百老匯，但不是。

lines.en: It was Shakespeare in the Park. -You were there? -Yeah, I came to see you. Absolutely. I'm a big fan. Yeah.
lines.zh: 是在「公園裡的莎士比亞」。－你去了？－對，我去看你。當然。我是你的大粉絲。對。

lines.en: You did that. -I feel really bad about the dig now. -You better keep digging me. Are you kidding me?
lines.zh: 你演了那個。－我現在為剛剛的吐槽覺得很抱歉。－你最好繼續吐槽我。你在開玩笑嗎？

lines.en: I have -- Please, if you don't laugh yourself, then come on.
lines.zh: 我有……拜託，如果你不會自嘲的話，那還得了。

lines.en: I saw you, and it was at the... -"Twelfth Night" at the Delacorte Theater. -...Delacorte Theater. -Yeah. -You were amazing. Do you get nervous?
lines.zh: 我去看你，是在……－在 Delacorte 劇場演的《第十二夜》。－……Delacorte 劇場。－對。－你太厲害了。你會緊張嗎？

lines.en: Does anything go wrong? Nothing went wrong when I saw you. -Nothing went wrong?
lines.zh: 有出過什麼差錯嗎？我去看的時候什麼差錯都沒有。－什麼差錯都沒有？

lines.en: Thank goodness. -No, you were perfect. -Well, because -- So, the Delacorte Theater is an outdoor theater in Central Park.
lines.zh: 謝天謝地。－沒有，你很完美。－嗯，因為……Delacorte 劇場是中央公園裡的一座露天劇場。

lines.en: And, so -- -And you're doing Shakespeare. -Doing Shakespeare.
lines.zh: 所以……－而你們在演莎士比亞。－演莎士比亞。

lines.en: And it rained almost every night.
lines.zh: 而且幾乎每天晚上都下雨。

lines.en: And, so, but it's kind of amazing, because every night, the last line of the show, which we actually sang, was for the rain, it raineth every day.
lines.zh: 但這有點神奇，因為每天晚上，戲的最後一句台詞，我們其實是用唱的，就是「因為雨天天都在下」。

lines.en: And so the audience, at that moment, always burst out laughing.
lines.zh: 所以觀眾在那一刻總是會爆笑。

lines.en: And the whole show was so joyful.
lines.zh: 整齣戲都好歡樂。

lines.en: I had such a wonderful time.
lines.zh: 我玩得非常開心。

lines.en: But one night, something -- I don't know if it went wrong, but something happened.
lines.zh: 但有一天晚上，有件事……我不知道算不算出差錯，但發生了一件事。

lines.en: And, so, there's this scene.
lines.zh: 所以，有這麼一場戲。

lines.en: My character, Viola -- she comes onto the stage.
lines.zh: 我的角色薇奧拉……她走上舞台。

lines.en: And I knew that the line was funny, but I couldn't figure out how to make it funny.
lines.zh: 我知道那句台詞很好笑，但我一直想不出怎麼讓它好笑。

lines.en: So every night, I was just trying something, just anything I could think of.
lines.zh: 所以每天晚上我都在嘗試，任何我想得到的方法都試。

lines.en: And I was, you know, go out there, audience wouldn't laugh, and I was like, "Tomorrow."
lines.zh: 你知道，我走上台，觀眾不笑，我就想：「明天再試。」

lines.en: And then, one night, I went out there and I said the line, and just the house went down. -You killed it. -Killed.
lines.zh: 然後有一天晚上，我走上台說出那句台詞，全場爆笑。－你殺翻全場。－殺翻了。

lines.en: And I was like, "Oh, I found it.
lines.zh: 我想：「喔，我找到了。

lines.en: This is such a good feeling."
lines.zh: 這感覺太棒了。」

lines.en: And I just like -- And so then, of course, I leaned into it, because you do.
lines.zh: 然後我就……當然，我就更加投入，因為人都會這樣。

lines.en: And so I lean into it and I'm just -- The audience is losing their minds.
lines.zh: 所以我更加投入，然後……觀眾笑到快瘋了。

lines.en: I look under the wings, the cast is losing their minds.
lines.zh: 我往側台看，其他演員也笑到快瘋了。

lines.en: I'm high-fiving myself in my head.
lines.zh: 我在腦中跟自己擊掌。

lines.en: I'm just like, "I've arrived. This is happening."
lines.zh: 我想：「我終於成功了。就是現在。」

lines.en: And I get offstage and I'm just like, "Well..."
lines.zh: 然後我下台，我就想：「嗯……」

lines.en: And they go, "Did you see the raccoons?" And I'm like, "The...what?"
lines.zh: 結果他們說：「你有看到那些浣熊嗎？」我說：「那些……什麼？」

lines.en: And then they just go, "Behind you.
lines.zh: 然後他們說：「在你後面。

lines.en: As soon as you came onstage, a family of raccoons came out. They were so cute.
lines.zh: 你一走上台，就有一家子浣熊跑出來。牠們好可愛。

lines.en: Couldn't focus on the scene because the raccoons were so cute."
lines.zh: 大家都沒辦法專心看戲，因為那些浣熊太可愛了。」

lines.en: So I was like, "Well, actually, high five to the raccoons." -See?
lines.zh: 所以我想：「嗯，其實應該跟浣熊擊掌才對。」－你看吧？

lines.en: You got to work with everybody. -Absolutely. -You got to work -- You play well with others.
lines.zh: 你得跟每個人合作。－絕對是。－你得……你很懂得跟別人合作。

lines.en: Let's talk about "The Idea of You." Oh, my gosh, buddy.
lines.zh: 我們來聊聊《The Idea of You》。喔，天啊，兄弟。

lines.en: The trailer alone has gotten over 125 million views. -Yeah. -It crushed, broke the record.
lines.zh: 光是預告片觀看次數就超過 1 億 2500 萬次。－對。－大獲成功，打破紀錄。

lines.en: Most-watched trailer of any streaming movie in history.
lines.zh: 史上觀看次數最多的串流電影預告片。

lines.en: Can we set up what the movie's about? -Oh, sure, sure.
lines.zh: 可以先說明一下這部電影在講什麼嗎？－喔，當然，當然。

lines.en: The story is about Solène Marchand, who is a woman who lives in Silver Lake. She's a gallery owner.
lines.zh: 故事是關於 Solène Marchand，一個住在 Silver Lake 的女人。她是藝廊老闆。

lines.en: She's a mom and she's got this really wonderful life.
lines.zh: 她是個媽媽，過著非常美好的生活。

lines.en: And she unexpectedly meets the lead singer of the biggest boy band in the world, a 24-year-old young man named Hayes Campbell. -Yeah. -And he thinks she's kind of great.
lines.zh: 然後她意外遇見了全世界最紅的男子團體主唱，一個 24 歲、叫 Hayes Campbell 的年輕人。－對。－而他覺得她很棒。

lines.en: And so the story is about how they fall in love. -Yeah.
lines.zh: 所以故事是在講他們如何墜入愛河。－對。

lines.en: Because you're just a mom and you're chaperoning this thing and you go to this thing and then you see this boy band. -I love hearing you describe my movie.
lines.zh: 因為你只是個媽媽，負責陪同這個活動，你去了這個活動，然後看到這個男子團體。－我好喜歡聽你描述我的電影。

lines.en: "Just a mom in this thing." -Yeah, you're a mom in this thing.
lines.zh: 「只是個媽媽，在這個活動裡。」－對，你是個在這個活動裡的媽媽。

lines.en: That's how I described it.
lines.zh: 我就是這樣描述的。

lines.en: Mom is chaperoning, like, a Coachella type of thing, like a giant outdoor festival thing, and the biggest boy band in the world, and then the lead singer -- -Oh, yes, so, my daughter is off watching St.
lines.zh: 媽媽在陪同，像是一個類似 Coachella 的活動，一個大型戶外音樂節，然後有全世界最紅的男子團體，然後主唱……－喔，對，所以我女兒跑去看 St.

lines.en: Vincent. Because she doesn't like the boy band anymore.
lines.zh: Vincent 的表演。因為她已經不喜歡那個男子團體了。

lines.en: She liked them in seventh grade.
lines.zh: 她七年級時喜歡他們。

lines.en: But, anyway, I have a backstage pass, so I'm a -- all-access thing.
lines.zh: 不過總之，我有後台通行證，所以我是……全區通行的那種。

lines.en: I have to go to the bathroom.
lines.zh: 我得去上廁所。

lines.en: Somebody tells me where the trailers are.
lines.zh: 有人告訴我休息車在哪裡。

lines.en: I go and I walk into the wrong trailer. -Yeah.
lines.zh: 我走過去，結果走錯了休息車。－對。

lines.en: And the rest is -- High jinks ensues.
lines.zh: 接下來就……一連串爆笑的事發生了。

lines.en: But remind me of the actor who plays the lead singer. -Nick Galitzine. -Oh, man, you guys have great chemistry.
lines.zh: 但提醒我一下，演主唱的演員是誰？－Nick Galitzine。－喔，天啊，你們兩個的化學反應超好。

lines.en: Did you know when he was auditioning?
lines.zh: 他試鏡的時候你就知道了嗎？

lines.en: You go, "Oh, this the guy." -Oh, yeah.
lines.zh: 你會想：「喔，就是他了。」－喔，對。

lines.en: Yeah, no, as soon as he -- I actually burst out laughing when he walked in, because -- Has anybody here read the book? -No, we don't read. -Well, you should.
lines.zh: 對，一看到他……其實他一走進來我就笑出來了，因為……這裡有人讀過那本書嗎？－沒有，我們不讀書的。－嗯，你們應該讀一下。

lines.en: It's fabulous. -This is "The Tonight Show."
lines.zh: 那本書超棒的。－這裡是《今夜秀》。

lines.en: Yeah, you want to go over to Stephen -- You want to go to Stephen Colbert if you want to get people that read books.
lines.zh: 對，你要去找 Stephen……如果你想找有在讀書的人，你要去 Stephen Colbert 那邊。

lines.en: We don't read. Lame! -Well, you have an awesome book in store for you.
lines.zh: 我們不讀書。遜！－嗯，那你們有一本很棒的書可以期待了。

lines.en: It's written by -- -Lame-O! We do Audible here. We do that.
lines.zh: 作者是……－遜斃了！我們這裡聽 Audible 有聲書。我們聽那個。

lines.en: Does that count? -I think it's time for you to -- to get me back. -Yeah, I know. -Okay, so -- -It's based on this book. -What's a book? -Yeah.
lines.zh: 那算嗎？－我想該你……該你把我拉回來了。－對，我知道。－好，所以……－它是根據這本書改編的。－書是什麼？－對。

lines.en: No, too late. No, too late.
lines.zh: 不，太遲了。不，太遲了。

lines.en: But this is based on the big best-selling book. -Well, the book does have a fan following somewhere.
lines.zh: 但這是根據一本超級暢銷書改編的。－嗯，那本書在某處確實有一群書迷。

lines.en: And -- Anyway, and I think the book is incredible.
lines.zh: 而且……總之，我覺得那本書很棒。

lines.en: And Hayes Campbell is so beautifully written in the book, and so we knew that we just really needed to find someone really special.
lines.zh: Hayes Campbell 在書裡寫得非常美，所以我們知道真的需要找到一個很特別的人。

lines.en: And he walked in, yeah, and I just thought, "Oh, that's Hayes Campbell."
lines.zh: 然後他走進來，對，我就想：「喔，那就是 Hayes Campbell。」

lines.en: And that was almost two years ago.
lines.zh: 那差不多是兩年前的事了。

lines.en: And now Nick and I have become really good friends, and, yeah, it's opened up in this beautiful way. -It's really great.
lines.zh: 現在 Nick 和我變成了很好的朋友，對，一切以很美好的方式展開了。－真的很棒。

lines.en: I want to show everyone a clip.
lines.zh: 我想給大家看一段片段。

lines.en: Here's Anne Hathaway in "The Idea of You."
lines.zh: 這是 Anne Hathaway 在《The Idea of You》裡的演出。

lines.en: Take a look. -Hi again. -Are you a part of that ASMR community that gets off on listening to people pee? -No,
lines.zh: 請看。－又見面了。－你是那種喜歡聽別人上廁所的 ASMR 社群成員嗎？－不，

lines.en: I wasn't -- -Because I don't think you can just go around assuming -- -It's actually my trailer. -What? -It's not literally mine.
lines.zh: 我不是……－因為我覺得你不能到處假設……－這其實是我的休息車。－什麼？－不是字面上屬於我的。

lines.en: You know, I don't own it. -This is your trailer? -Yeah, I'm in the band.
lines.zh: 你知道，不是我買的。－這是你的休息車？－對，我是樂團成員。

lines.en: We're performing on the main stage.
lines.zh: 我們在主舞台表演。

lines.en: You know, I'm Hayes Campbell. -August Moon? -Yeah. -Well, I absolutely know who you are. Um, anyway...I'll... -Yeah. Come on.
lines.zh: 你知道，我是 Hayes Campbell。－August Moon？－對。－嗯，我當然知道你是誰。嗯，總之……我就……－對。來吧。

lines.en: You know how to do it. Anne Hathaway, everybody.
lines.zh: 你知道怎麼做的。各位，Anne Hathaway。

lines.en: "The Idea of You" begins streaming on Prime Video this Thursday.
lines.zh: 《The Idea of You》本週四在 Prime Video 上線。

lines.en: We'll be right back with Melanie Lynskey. Stick around, everybody.
lines.zh: 我們馬上回來，下一位來賓是 Melanie Lynskey。請別走開，各位。
